location.title: Set your location

partner.vehicle_registration_hint: As on your RC, e.g. TS 16 AB 1234

partner.online_hint: You'll receive delivery requests from nearby shops.

partner.no_history: Your completed deliveries will appear here.

partner.order_preparing: The shop is still preparing this order. You can confirm pickup once it's marked ready.
partner.pickup_hint: Confirm at the shop — your location is checked.
partner.prepaid_no_cash: Paid online — don't collect any cash.
